preconditions.description: The number of lines of input is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each line contains a command of at most 100 characters.
preconditions.description: Each command consists of one or more words separated by spaces and ends with a period.

preconditions.expression: Each word in the command uses only lowercase and uppercase letters a-z.
preconditions.description: The input is well-formed and does not contain any invalid characters.

postconditions.expression: For each line that starts with 'Simon says', output the rest of the line.
postconditions.description: If a line does not start with 'Simon says', it should be ignored.
